candidates.label: HP-gradient 4-band tight: push aggressively at high HP, kite deep at low HP
candidates.rationale: Pure durability axis sweep — 4 HP bands each targeting a different durability bucket in MAP-Elites. Should populate cells outside the currently-occupied high-durability corner. Monotonic, easy to debug.
candidates.bandBody: function(f){const hp=f.hp/(f.maxhp||1);if(hp>=0.75){const min=50,max=90;return {min,max,rush:min,role:'assassin',hp};}if(hp>=0.5){const min=90,max=140;return {min,max,rush:min+10,role:'bruiser',hp};}if(hp>=0.25){const min=160,max=220;return {min,max,rush:max-5,role:'ranged',hp};}const min=250,max=330;return {min,max,rush:max,role:'ranged',hp};}

candidates.label: Q-ready → tight 55-95 burst; else wide 180-260 patient (high tempo variance)
candidates.rationale: Pure CD-axis read on f.cd.q — a signal the archive hasn't exploited. Tight on Q ready, wide when cooling. Should produce HIGH tempo variance (burst-wait oscillation) distinct from pack-robust-peel-fused's steady-state bands.

candidates.label: Stomp-aware defensive: stomp≥0.25 → very wide 220-320; else mid 100-150
candidates.rationale: Reads this._stomp (engine's 'enemy-sharpening' signal). When stomp high, enemy aim/jitter sharpens; shifting player wider should protect lazy/panicky personas. Targets low-engage × high-durability cell distinct from current 1,3,3,3.

candidates.label: Support-triage: dying ally (<0.3hp) → very close 45-80 tank; else balanced 95-140
candidates.rationale: Escalates peel from 0.5-threshold to a true 0.3-emergency-triage. Tank role rushes right onto ally. Should fill a HIGH-durability-sacrifice cell (max output for team, less self-survival).

candidates.label: Oscillator: both CDs cooling → wide, both ready → tight, mixed → mid (pure cd-combo)
candidates.rationale: Reads BOTH f.cd.q and f.cd.e. Creates a 3-state deterministic oscillation: (both cool) → patient, (mixed) → bruiser, (both ready) → burst. Forces tempo diversity; should NOT land in same cell as single-CD rule.
candidates.bandBody: function(f){const hp=f.hp/(f.maxhp||1);const q=(f.cd&&f.cd.q||0);const e=(f.cd&&f.cd.e||0);const bothReady=q<=0.15&&e<=0.15;const bothCool=q>=2.5&&e>=2.5;if(bothReady){const min=50,max=85;return {min,max,rush:min,role:'assassin',hp};}if(bothCool){const min=200,max=280;return {min,max,rush:max,role:'ranged',hp};}const min=110,max=160;return {min,max,rush:min+10,role:'bruiser',hp};}
